gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.1: Yip yip! Hold on tight, new Guhvatar. Appa flies faster than he looks.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.2: A hundred years in a cheese ball. My legs are still asleep. Luckily my tummy is wide awake, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.3: Momo Guh sniffs your ear, decides your shoulder belongs to him, and settles down on it, very pleased.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.4: See those clouds over there? The Southern Air Temple floats behind them. My home. Now a little bit yours too.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.5: Water, earth, fire, air. Four elements. Sounds like a lot? It is a lot. But you have time. And nibbles.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.6: You know the best thing about flying? Nobody asks you anything up here. Only the wind, and the wind always says hi.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.start.7: There she is! Appa can already smell his stable. Hold on to your ears, we're landing.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h1_h2.1: Off to the Northern Water Tribe! That's where you learn waterbending. Brr, I hope your fur is warm enough.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h1_h2.2: The water master there is called Pakguh. He's very strict. And he has a very big moustache. Those two go together, I think.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h1_h2.3: That was Zuka. He's been hunting me since... well, since yesterday. He wants his honour back, he says.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h1_h2.4: I kind of get him. Everybody is looking for something. He's just looking in the wrong place.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h1_h2.5: Momo Guh crawls out from under Appa's fur. Only now that the ship is really gone does he dare to squeak again.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h1_h2.6: Ice! Miles of ice! I'm going to slide on my belly in a minute. Coming?
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.1: Okay team, the plan. Step one: we land in Ba Sing Guh. Step two: ...I'm still working on that.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.2: Aang, you're sitting crooked on Appa's head. Lean forward a little, then he steers more calmly.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.3: I've been flying him for a hundred years, Katara!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.4: You slept for a hundred years, Aang. That's not the same thing.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.5: See? I told you he'd come back! Nobody ever listens to Sokka Guh.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.6: Momo Guh pops up with a dried fish in his mouth. Sokka Guh's emergency fish.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.7: Hey! That was my emergency fish! For emergencies! That WAS an emergency!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.8: Zuka looked... tired. Almost sad. Did you see that too?
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.9: Everybody deserves a second chance. Even princes with a funny ponytail.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h2_h3.10: The wall! Look how big that wall is! I could make a whole plan around that.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.1: I hate flying. There's no GROUND up here. I can't feel a thing, Sokka!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.2: That's why it's called flying, Toph.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.3: Everybody ready for the Fire Nation? We have to blend in with the crowd. Nothing silly.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.4: I'm just going to sit somewhere and pretend to be a rock. I'm really good at that.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.5: Honestly, I'm a little scared. But with you all here... a lot less.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.6: Plan for the disguise: I already made a moustache. Out of Appa fluff.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.7: Appa rumbles, very deep and very offended. Momo Guh tries to eat the moustache.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.8: Are we there yet? ...Are we there yet? I'm going to hug Appa's fur until we are.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.9: Whatever happens down there: we do it together. Deal?
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.10: Everybody puts a hand on Appa's fur. Even Toph. Appa rumbles, softly now.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.h3_h4.11: There it is. The crater. Stay close together, team.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.1: Appa likes this route. I can tell by his ears.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.2: You know what I'd do if I wasn't the Guhvatar? Air scooter. All day long.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.3: Look, a Crumb Jelly! Or a cloud. Or a jelly that wants to be a cloud.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.4: Are you comfy? There's a little blanket in the saddle basket if you're cold.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.5: It's so quiet up here. Not thinking about anything for a while. That's allowed too, you know.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.6: I drew a map on the way. It's upside down, but it IS pretty.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.7: Anyone hungry? I've got... no. I had. MOMO!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.8: If I ever get my own sky bison, I'll call him Appa Two. Or Bisonbert. Bisonbert is better.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.9: I can't feel the ground. I can't feel the ground. I can't feel the ground...
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.10: Tell me when we land. Then I'll pretend I enjoyed this again.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.11: Flying on Appa beats my old ship. At least nobody is shouting up here.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.12: Uncle would say the journey matters more than where you arrive. And then he would ask for tea.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.13: Momo Guh curls up in your hood and snores very softly.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.14: Momo Guh pinches a nibble from Sokka Guh's bag. Sokka Guh only notices much later.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.15: Appa's six legs move slowly with the wind, as if he is swimming through the air.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.chat.vrij.16: Somewhere far away something is singing, low and long. The void is less empty than you think.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.team.zuidelijke_l: This is where I learned to fly. And to fall. Mostly to fall, nyeg.
Monk Guhatso always said: you can't float on an empty tummy. That's why he ate so much pie.
Aang shows me every corner. He laughs, but at the empty rooms his ears go very quiet.
A temple in the clouds... At home we only had snow. Lots and lots of snow.
I made a map of the temple. It's wrong, but it's very pretty.
Why are all the doors here round? Who builds round doors? ...Okay. They're quite handy.
A temple that floats. Great. A whole temple I can't feel a single bit of.
Tell me when we're back on real ground. I'll wait here. On a rock. Very still.
I once stood here with a ship full of plans. Now I stand here with a cup of tea. That feels better.
Aang wants to show me the airball tower. I have a feeling I'm going to lose.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.team.noordelijke_: Remember my first water whip? I hit Pakguh's moustache. By accident! ...Mostly by accident.
The ice here is so slippery. I've made Appa slip three times already. He didn't think it was funny.
This is where I learned I don't have to prove anything to people who won't look. Only to myself.
Grandma's necklace catches the moonlight so beautifully here. Then she feels very close.
Every evening I look at the moon for a bit. And the moon looks back, I think. That's normal, right?
Plan for today: fishing. Plan for tomorrow: more fishing. I'm getting better and better at plans.
Ice. It's like somebody put the ground in a glass of water. I feel everything... blurry.
They say it's beautiful here. I say: cold. We're both right.
I was here once in secret, wearing a blue mask. Nobody knows. ...Well, now you do. Shh.
The people here still look at me a bit sideways. Fair enough. I'm doing my best.
There's no nibble shortage here, they say. I checked. There IS a nibble shortage. In my tummy.
I still miss Appa every time I see these walls. Luckily he's back. I hug him twice as much.
This city keeps secrets in its walls. I still don't quite trust them.
Uncle Miroh's tea house smells of jasmine all the way to this square. It makes everything a bit softer.
I saw a whole cabbage stall get smashed here. Poor man. I came up with a plan for it: less cabbage.
The monorail! I want another go. And another. For research, obviously.
This isn't my city, but the stones know me. They say you stand well on your feet.
Want to see how the Blind Bandit moves a wall? ...Kidding. Or not. Mind your toes.
I poured tea for strangers here. It was the calmest thing I've ever done. Don't tell Uncle.
Uncle says a good cup of tea is never in a hurry. I'm learning. Slowly.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.team.vuurnatie_ho: I thought I'd be scared here. But the people... they're just people. With really tasty buns.
The turtle-ducklings in the palace pond already know me. I may have given them a bit too much bread.
We came here as strangers in disguise. Now the bakers say hello to us. Things can change.
You should see Zuka when nobody is watching. He feeds the ducklings. With a very small smile.
You know what I like best here? Everything. Except the extra hot fire flakes. My tongue is still mad at me.
I saw the play about us. In real life I was much funnier. Really.
The ground is warm here. I can live with that. Warm feet, happy Toph.
Everywhere I hear people whispering about the Guhvatar. You're famous, nyeg. Try not to sweat.
This was a home full of fear. I want it to become a home full of tea. Uncle is helping.
I walk here WITH you now instead of chasing you. The streets feel wider.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.komt: Behind you a steam whistle sounds. A grey ship with a red flag dives out of the clouds.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.zuka.h1_h2: GUHVATAR! You didn't really think I'd just let you go?! Fire!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.zuka.h2_h3: There you are again! Wherever you fly, I fly after you. That's a promise!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.team.h2_h3: Him again?! Does that guy really have no hobbies?
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.uitleg: Fireballs! Press a movement key and Appa dives aside: left, right, jump (up) or sneak (down).
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.weg: A sad little puff comes out of Zuka's smokestack. Coughing, the ship sinks away behind you. Nobody has so much as a scratch.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.score: Appa dodged %s of the %s fireballs. He snorts proudly.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.vuurbal: FIREBALL! Dive away: left, right, jump or sneak!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.geraakt: Boom! Appa gets pushed aside. He shakes out his fur: all fine, just a whiff of barbecue.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.jacht.ontweken: Appa dives away. The fireball hisses harmlessly past.
Have a seat, youngster. The rest of the pub has heard it a hundred times. And laughed a hundred times.
Sixty years ago I sailed a grease ship through the void. I was looking for the White Nibble (don't ask). In the middle of the night I heard something singing. Low. So low my nibbles trembled.
Then I saw him. A whale as big as an island, with little stars on his skin and ears like saucers. He looked at me. And then he was gone.
I never saw him again. They say he only shows himself to those who believe in him. And I... maybe I lost a bit of my believing.
So. Will you laugh along with the rest? Or do you believe an old captain?
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.ongelovi: Hm. You too. Come back if you ever want to believe. I'll be sitting here anyway, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.geloof: You believe me? Really? ...Then you have to see him. Fly to x %s, z %s, far beyond the harbor, above the void. Wait there. Quietly. He comes when you listen.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.wacht: Fly to x %s, z %s, above the void, and wait there very quietly. Don't get impatient: whales don't wear watches.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.bewijs: You saw him?! My ears are tingling! But the pub will only believe it with proof. Feed him a Nibble Chorus Fruit: he thanks you with a Void Pearl. Bring it to me.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.temmen: He's still swimming around, isn't he? Feed him often and he'll start to trust you. %s of %s. Then he'll be yours.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.klaar.1: My horn, on your whale. A story can't go on any better than that, youngster.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.klaar.2: Say hi to him from me when you see him. Tell him: the old captain is laughing again.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.klaar.3: I sit here every evening with a glass of nibble juice. And at least now they listen, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kapitein.hoorn: The captain presses his old horn into your hands. 'Sixty years I blew on it and nobody ever came. Feed him often and he'll be yours. And then he comes when YOU blow.'
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kroegbaas.spot.1: Did Grandpa Whale get you onto his bench again? Sixty years, the same story. He's sweet, really. But a whale? Come on.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kroegbaas.spot.2: What'll it be? Nibble juice? And if you ask about that whale, you get a free laugh with it.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kroegbaas.twijfel: You say you saw him? ...Without proof it's just a second tall tale, buddy.
A whale as big as an island. Of course. And I'm the Guh King. Bring proof, then I'll believe it.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kroegbaas.spijt.1: For sixty years I laughed at him. Now he gets free nibble juice every evening. The least I can do.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.kroegbaas.spijt.2: Sometimes at night I hear something singing, out in the void. Then I smile. So does the captain.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.eigen: A Void Whale Guh of your own
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.van_ander: This whale already swims with somebody else. Find a free one, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.vertrouwen: The whale sings a soft thank-you. He trusts you a little bit more: %s of %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.getemd: The whale sings a new song. Just for you. This is YOUR whale now!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.uitleg: Blow the horn and he comes. Stand on his back with the horn in your hand and he swims where you look (look up or down: he climbs or sinks). Sneak + blow: furnish his back.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.kist_niet: This chest belongs to the boss of this whale. The whale winks, but won't let you in.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.tuin_niet: This little garden belongs to the boss of this whale. Looking is allowed.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.tuin: You pick two Nibble Chorus Fruits from the whale garden. Your whale is already smacking his lips.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.tuin_morge: The little garden is resting. Something new will grow tomorrow, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.dutje: You take a nap on the soft whale back. His song rocks you. You feel completely rested.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.wakker: You're still completely rested. Another nap later.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.walvis.huisje: You peek into the little house: a hammock, a teapot and a map with all your travels on it. It smells of nibbles.
item.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvishoorn.lore: He blew on it for sixty years. Now, at last, somebody comes.
item.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvishoorn.tool: Blow (in the Guheinde): your own whale comes to you.
On his back with the horn in your hand: he swims where you look.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.hoorn.geen: You blow. A deep note rolls through the void... but there is no whale listening to you yet.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.hoorn.niet_hier: Your whale only swims in the void of the Guheinde. That's where he hears you.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.hoorn.komt: You toot the horn. Far away a low song answers: your whale is on his way!
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wacht: Your story flight to %s is still waiting. Click Appa and pick the star to fly on, or "On with the story". Lost Appa? Blow your Appa Whistle, or click the cheese ball at the Nibble Mountain.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.uitleg: Pick one and Appa flies there (steering is allowed). ★ = your chapter, ↻ = straight to your step.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.leeg: You don't know any buildings in the Guheinde yet. Go exploring, and Appa will remember them.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.niet_hier: Appa can't follow you into the Spirit World. Return to your body first.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.niet_op_app: Sit on Appa's head first, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.kan_niet: Appa can't fly there right now.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.op_weg: Yip yip! On our way to %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.ver: Appa is too far away. Call him with the Appa Whistle first.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.nog_niet: Appa is still sniffing out the way there. Try again in a moment.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.leegte.op_weg: Appa rumbles, swishes his tail and dives into the void with you, on the way to %s...
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.doel.kroeg: to the harbor pub of the Void Harbor
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.doel.wachten: to the captain's spot, above the void
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wachten.0: The void is quiet. You wait...
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wachten.1: No wind. No birds. You wait a little longer...
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wachten.2: Was that... something? You hold your breath.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wachten.3: Deep below you the silence trembles.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wachten.4: There. A song, very far away.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.wacht_weg: You're no longer at the captain's spot. Go back and wait above the void.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.inrichting.uitleg: Choose what stands on his back. Items in the chests are kept, even when you put the chests away.
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.uitleg: In harbor pub The Chonky Whale an old captain guh has been telling of a whale that sings for sixty years. Everybody laughs at him. Only those who believe get to see it.
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.nu.0: Talk to the old captain guh in harbor pub The Chonky Whale. Everybody laughs at his story. You listen.
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.waar.0: Harbor pub The Chonky Whale, in the Void Harbor
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.nu.1: Fly to the spot the captain named and wait there, above the void. Quietly. Listen.
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.waar.1: The void, far beyond the Void Harbor (your compass points to the spot)
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.nu.2: Feed the whale a Nibble Chorus Fruit. Bring the Void Pearl you get to the captain.
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.waar.2: Harbor pub The Chonky Whale, in the Void Harbor
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.nu.3: Feed a whale a Nibble Chorus Fruit eight times. Then he trusts you and becomes yours.
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.waar.3: At a Void Whale Guh, between the outer islands
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.nu.klaar: You have your own whale! Blow the horn and he comes.
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.waar.klaa: Anywhere in the void of the Guheinde
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.kort.0: Listen to the old captain in the harbor pub
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.kort.1: Wait above the void, at the captain's spot
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.kort.2: Bring a Void Pearl to the captain
gui.guhs.verhalen.leegtewalvis.kort.3: Feed a whale Nibble Chorus Fruits
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis.stil: It is dead quiet in the void. No wind. No birds. Only you, and your own breathing.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis.lied: Then you hear it. Low, very far away... and yet everywhere at once.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis.omhoog: Out of the depths beneath you something rises. Something big. Something very, VERY big.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis.oogjes: Two enormous guh eyes look at you. Two round ears flap. And he sings. For you.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis.gelijk: The old captain was right. All those years. The Great Singing One really exists.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis.gelooft: And now he knows that you believe in him. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.sp: Look who's here! Come to hear a tall tale from Grandpa Whale too?
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.la: Hahaha! The Great Singing One! Tell us again about that time he...
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.pa: You lay the Void Pearl on the lectern. It glows, soft and purple. The whole pub falls silent.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.fl: That... that's a Void Pearl. You only get those from a...
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.ze: Sixty years I told it. Sixty years you all laughed. But this one here... this one believed me.
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.so: Captain... I'm sorry. Really. The next round is on the house. For everyone!
scene.guhs.einde2_reizen_walvis_kroeg.ji: And to you, youngster. Come and sit with me in a bit. I've got something for you.
Sit on your &dAppa Guh&r's head and blow the &6Appa Whistle&r. You get a list of every building you know in the Guheinde. Pick one and Appa flies there: you may steer, or let go and he flies himself. Your team rides along on his back.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_reizen_gast.d: Climb into a friend's Appa Guh &dsaddle basket&r and fly somewhere together. As long as you travel with them you are their &bguest&r: you may go where they may go, and you see their team. Your own story stays your own.
On the way to the next chapter &cZuka's ship&r sometimes shows up. He fires fireballs that only push. Press a movement key when one comes and Appa dives aside. How many can you dodge?
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_reizen_walvis: In harbor pub &6The Chonky Whale&r in the &eVoid Harbor&r an old captain guh tells of a whale that sings. The whole pub laughs. Listen to his story... and believe him.
Fly to the spot the captain named and wait there above the void. Very quietly. First you hear the song...
Feed the whale a &5Nibble Chorus Fruit&r and bring the &dVoid Pearl&r to the captain. Now the pub has to believe!

Feed a whale a Nibble Chorus Fruit eight times. Then he trusts you and becomes yours: blow &6the Captain's Horn&r and he comes, stand on his back with the horn in your hand and he swims where you look.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_reizen_ingeri: A Little House on a Whale
Sneak and blow the horn: furnish your whale's back. A little house, two chests that really keep items, a bed for a nap, a little garden with Nibble Chorus Fruits, lanterns and a flag in your colour.
gui.guhs.einde2_reizen.fluit.hervat: On with the story (straight to your step)
